pages.cannotDeleteRoot: The home page cannot be deleted.
pages.dragHint: Drag to sort, drop onto a page to nest it

grid.pasteWrongInput: The copied action cannot be placed on {{input}}.

inspector.title: Properties
inspector.nothingSelectedHint: Pick a key or dial on the left.
inspector.empty: This position is not assigned yet.
inspector.longPressHint: Second action when the key is held longer than {{ms}} ms.
inspector.label: Label

icons.title: Choose icon
icons.dropOrClick: Drop a file here or click

background.title: Background
background.transparentHint: Lets the page's wallpaper show through. Without a page image the segment stays black, so nothing changes.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.reorderHint: Drag plugins by the handle to reorder them — the order also applies to the action list in the editor.
plugins.discardChanges: There are unsaved changes. Close anyway?
plugins.dropArchive: Drop a plugin archive (.zip) here or click
plugins.uninstallConfirm: Remove “{{name}}”? Assignments using this plugin will be deleted.
plugins.trustWarning: A plugin is program code running with your permissions. Only install plugins from sources you trust.
plugins.requestTitle: A plugin wants to be installed
plugins.screensaversHint: Draw the screensaver across the whole deck. Pick one under Settings → Screensaver.
plugins.wallpapersHint: Draw the background behind the dial segments. Pick one under Settings → Touch strip wallpaper.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autostartHint: Starts the backend together with the graphical session. Takes effect at the next login — the running service is left alone.
settings.swipeHint: Swipe left to go forward, right to go back. Tapping still goes to the assigned action.
settings.swipeWraps: Wrap around to the first page
settings.exportHint: Saves the complete configuration as a JSON file.

screensaver.title: Screensaver
screensaver.hint: After a period of inactivity, lays one image across all keys and the touch strip. Any input ends it immediately.
screensaver.testing: The screensaver is running — press a key to end it.
screensaver.previewHint: This is how the image reaches the device. The black bands are the bezels between the keys — whatever falls there will not be visible.
screensaver.afterHint: Counted from the last input on the deck. Independent of dimming.

wallpaper.title: Touch strip wallpaper
wallpaper.hint: Sits behind the four dial segments of this page. Every page can have its own image.
wallpaper.previewHint: The full strip. The thin lines mark where the four dial segments meet.
wallpaper.sizeHint: The strip is 800 × 100 pixels, one segment 200 × 100. An image with this aspect ratio is not cropped.
wallpaper.opacityHint: Below 100% the image recedes so icons and labels stay readable.
wallpaper.slotHint: The image only shows where a segment has no background of its own. Giving a dial a colour deliberately covers it.
